summary: microsoft/agent-lightning là framework huấn luyện để phát triển và triển khai AI agents, tích hợp LLM, reinforcement learning và MLOps.
usecases: Automate complex research and data analysis with AI agents.
Deploy continuous MLOps pipelines for agent training and iteration.
Build strategic decision-support systems using reinforcement learning.
ideas: Combine with real-time graphics to create game characters with self-learning AI behaviors.
Develop a personal financial automation system that analyzes market trends via AI agents.
Create a personal AI assistant that improves through continuous feedback loops.
